sentences.text: These second bail applications have been filed by the petitioners under Section 439 Cr.P.C. seeking regular bail in FIR No.347/2022 registered at Police Station Itava, District Kota Rural for the offence(s) under Section(s) 419, 420, 406 & 120-B of IPC and under Section(s) 66(D) & 67 of IT Act.

entities.text: Police Station Itava, District Kota Rural
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned counsels for petitioners submit that accused-petitioners are innocent and have falsely been implicated in these cases.
They further submit that offences are triable by Magistrate, investigation is complete and charge sheet has already been filed.
They also submit that accused-petitioners are in judicial custody since 28.09.2022 and the conclusion of the trial will take long time, hence petitioners may be enlarged on bail.
Learned
Public Prosecutor appearing for the State has opposed these second bail applications.

Taking into consideration the overall facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on the merits and demerits of the case, (3 of 3) [CRLMB- 18137/2022] this Court deems it just and proper to enlarge the petitioners on bail.

Accordingly, second bail applications filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. are allowed and it is ordered that accused-petitioners 1.Ghanshyam Sharma Son Of Ramesh Chand Sharma, 2.Aais Son Of Aash Mohammad & 3.Rahul Jangid S/o Shri Prabhudayal shall be released on bail, provided each of them furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with two sureties of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of the trial Court, with the stipulation that petitioners shall appear before that Court on all subsequent dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.

(UMA SHANKER VYAS),J DANISH USMANI /02 & 03 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
